cast.name: Creator
cast.description: young Indian woman, upbeat UGC creator

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: My skin looked dull every single morning.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple sits opposite yellow on the colour wheel, so it helps cancel yellow-looking dullness.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: It starts lavender, then blends completely clear.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Zero white cast, zero purple residue.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: It's made for Indian skin, with 4% niacinamide for a brighter-looking finish.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: And SPF 50 PA+++ gives me the daily protection I actually need.
